entries.value: "`bsc lan` — the command surface for the emit-only LAN sensor: what this host exposes, the keys the stream needs, and a socket-free dry run over real Suricata output."

lead: # The sensor ships as its own binary rather than as part of the unified `bsc`,
# which carries bundled DuckDB. See src/main.rs, and tests/lean.rs, which fails
# the build if that ever stops being true.
sections.name: [[bin]]

lead: # The ONE channel for asking the running app to do something (#3274).
# Key material must come from the OS CSPRNG. Nothing else is acceptable here and
# a test pins that two runs differ.
# The monitor-mode capture socket (src/capture.rs). AF_PACKET has no std
# equivalent; bsc-rf stays libc-free so its lean-closure test keeps holding.
# What a captured frame MEANS — parsing only; this crate owns the socket.
# DENY, NOT FORBID, and the difference is load-bearing. One audited module here holds a raw file
# descriptor and lifts this with `#[allow(unsafe_code)]` plus a SAFETY note per call; `forbid`
# cannot be overridden anywhere, which would mean either no capture at all or the unsafe living in
# a crate with no business holding a descriptor. Moved out of `src/lib.rs` when the crate root
# became the SHARED one (`a-crate-root-is-shared-so-a-crate-is-one-file`) — a manifest lint is
# exactly a crate-level attribute, so the inner `#[allow]` still overrides it.
